detail: Intended statement: for every state s satisfying the controller invariant (windowp, connsp, ready session) and every step event e, with pair=(fn-csp-step s e) and effs=(cadr pair): (implies (member-eq :journal (strip-cars effs)) (and (equal (strip-cars-count :journal effs) 1) (equal (cdr (assoc :journal effs)) (fn-cu-round-cursor r2)) (<= (fn-csp-offset s) (fn-csp-replay s)) (fn-csp-conns-idlep (fn-csp-conns s-after-settling-reply)))). Local pieces already proved: fn-csp-record-done-journals-only-settled, fn-csp-terminator-journals-nothing, fn-csp-local-verdict-final-journals; the keystone fn-csp-step-final-verdict-journals covers the settling-reply caller. Open: the record-done caller in every mode and the global statement over fn-csp-step. Cites PRF-1335/1336 (the offer window; header of books/peer-catchup-spool.lisp). Needs defteeth (positive witness a reachable state built by fn-csp-begin plus steps, per-hypothesis breaks, a mutation) before it counts.
notes: 10-06 22:52 Proved as fn-csp-journals-only-a-settled-batch in books/peer-catchup-spool-body.lisp (drain invariant fn-csp-drain-inv + journal classification). Differs from the detail: the ready-session hypothesis is dropped (fn-cu-session-step-pair never journals, proved), and the conclusion adds the one-leading-journal shape and that the step reaches :done/:status with every conn idle; the offset<=replay claim is on the pre-state. Teeth in tests/acl2/peer-catchup-spool-tests.lisp. Certified persvati run-20261007T022436Z-3555.
title: Catch-up spool controller owes fn-csp-journals-only-a-settled-batch: a :journal effect of fn-csp-step is emitted only when the spool cursor is at the batch end and every conn binding has settled
